title: Chapter 253
text:
[No pop-up window, free to read!]

Devin tested the waters carefully, and after a while, he realized that Black Phantom did not crush him like he had expected, so he gradually relaxed.

"So, the legendary Black Phantom is not that strong. I was worried for nothing. The rumors were all exaggerated."

Devin was energized, and his confidence surged. He was no longer afraid and started to attack ferociously.

The bone-armored giant fought with the mecha warrior, and the sound of fists colliding with the mecha was endless. The executive officer who followed him was originally wary of Black Phantom, but now, seeing that Devin was able to exchange blows with Black Phantom, he was very surprised.

"When did the captain become stronger?"

"No, it seems that Black Phantom has become weaker!"

"After escaping for so long, it's impossible for him to maintain his peak condition. He's at his weakest now!"

The executive officers' morale was greatly boosted, and they were no longer afraid. They all rushed up to attack.

According to the importance that the leader placed on him, if they could kill Han Xiao, it would definitely be a great achievement!

Kill him while he's weak!

As the supers attacked, the surroundings were damaged by the aftershocks and became full of holes. The army was not idle either, and they threw cannonballs at Hella like they were free.

Hila was in a precarious situation, retreating step by step. She gritted her teeth and endured the endless waves of attacks. If it was her original combat style, she would not have allowed herself to be in such a situation. If not for this mechanical suit, she would have been heavily injured long ago. She was very surprised by the defensive capabilities of Viper.

The leader's eyes lit up. "His condition has deteriorated. Very good, there are fewer variables now!"

He originally wanted to use the five veteran executive officers to hold Han Xiao back, but he realized that Han Xiao's strength had deteriorated. He must have been exhausted from the high-intensity escape. The leader was very surprised.

At this time, Black Phantom was held back by Devin, and he was in a quagmire.

"Who is this executive officer? He has great potential," the leader said.

The assistant quickly checked the information and said, "His name is Devin. His resume … uh, there's nothing special."

The leader scolded, "We're at war now, and every strong person is an important resource. It's a serious dereliction of duty to miss any one of them!"

…

Hella attracted everyone's attention. While the battle raged on, Han Xiao snuck into the troops and secretly planted bombs on the chassis of the various vehicles.

No one saw him. Dean's special ability was very useful. Even if Han Xiao stood in front of a soldier, he would not be discovered. However, Han Xiao was still very careful. Once he entered combat mode, his stealth would disappear.

"This Esper Ability is indeed suitable for being a cat burglar. No wonder Dean was able to steal secrets. He probably went to many good places. Damn it …" Han Xiao was a little envious. When he was in his teenage years, he liked to fantasize about having an invisibility ability. It was once one of his' thirty-three goals in life ', but he only crossed it off after he experienced more.

In the invisible state, Han Xiao's perception of his surroundings was completely different. It was as if everything around him was covered with a layer of fog, making it appear unreal. This reminded him of an old movie that he had watched in his free time. The plot of the movie was about an invisible ring, and the feeling of wearing it was very similar. The movie seemed to be called 'The Ring of the King' or something.

This troop had limited vehicles, so Han Xiao finished planting the bombs very quickly. He left behind a few vehicles for escape.

There are still two minutes left. When the explosion happens, I just need to grab one of the vehicles to escape.

So far, everything was going smoothly.

Han Xiao returned to the vicinity of the battlefield. Hila was currently being surrounded and had almost no strength to fight back. Just by relying on the mechanical suit that she was not familiar with, she could not block the attacks of a group of executive officers and super soldiers.

Han Xiao took out the communicator connected to the mechanical suit and whispered, "I'm about eighty meters north of you. There will be a big explosion soon. Come over and switch with me immediately. There's an armored off-road vehicle nearby!"

Although Hella could not see Han Xiao, she heard his order.

She counted down the time. Ten seconds … five seconds … three seconds. At this time, Han Xiao pressed the trigger button.
